=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- prompts/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt:1-6 (and prompts/_templates/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The prompt's first paragraph is the `=== HEAL COUNTERFACTUAL CHECK ===` banner instead of `Role: ... Goal: ...`, so identity-recall metadata extraction raises `metadata_extract_failed`.
  WHY: CI job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails in `test_identity_recall_render.sh` (run 40660788825), and any render with identity recall on fails; reviewers labelled it BLOCKER.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:212-235 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_evaluate_heal_counterfactual` accepts the `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL:` marker from any unfenced line in the plan, not only inside the `## Counterfactual check` section.
  WHY: A heal plan with `PASS` in an unrelated section, or with no counterfactual section, is auto-approved by plan.yml and the poller. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said MAJOR (confidence 3); the others said BLOCKER. Highest used.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:249-254 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: PARTIAL job names are matched as unrestricted substrings of `## Deferred scope` bullets.
  WHY: `PARTIAL: build` is approved when only `build-image` is deferred, so an undeferred failing job is auto-approved.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18117-18156 (also .github/workflows/plan.yml:3017-3037) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The unknown-route branch builds a `hold` result (`heal_route_unknown`) before `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE_ENABLED` is consulted, in both the poller and plan.yml.
  WHY: Setting the rollback flag to `false` does not release the hold, and ordinary issues can be held on a details-map cache miss. The poller posts no hold comment for this case, so the issue can sit silently in `ai:awaiting-approval`.
- agents.d/8249-heal-plan-counterfactual-gate.md:1 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment targets `## Implement scope-lock label` (agents.md:1755), an unrelated section, for the heal counterfactual gate documentation.
  WHY: The documentation lands under the wrong heading. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said NIT, minimax_minimax-m3 said MAJOR, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said MAJOR (task gap). Highest used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18177-18179 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_counterfactual_hold_notify` returns early for `heal_route_unknown` holds, so no comment or Telegram warning is posted.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell a transient hold from a real FAIL hold, because the log shows `STALL_SKIP reason=heal_counterfactual_hold` in both cases. The reviewer called it a NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:`_evaluate_heal_counterfactual` (unmatched = [...] substring match) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A job named on the `PARTIAL:` line counts as deferred if its text is a substring of any `## Deferred scope` bullet, so `build` is deferred by a bullet that only mentions `build-image`.
  WHY: `PARTIAL: build` with the bullet `- build-image still times out` returns `approve` / `partial_jobs_deferred`, so plan.yml and the poller auto-approve a plan that leaves an undeferred job failing.
- prompts/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt and prompts/_templates/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt:1-2 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_extract_identity_recall_metadata_or_raise` (scripts/render_prompt.py:510-538) takes the `===` banner as the first paragraph, which does not match `ROLE_GOAL_LINE_RE`, so it raises `metadata_extract_failed`.
  WHY: CI job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails in `tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh`, and any render with identity recall on fails. The fix is to move the banner below the Role/Goal paragraph or fold Role/Goal into the first paragraph in both copies.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:`_evaluate_heal_counterfactual` (scan of `_unfenced_lines(lines)`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The marker line is accepted from anywhere in the plan, not only inside the `## Counterfactual check` section.
  WHY: A heal plan with no such section, or with the line in an unrelated section, is approved on `PASS`, so the per-job failure walk is not enforced.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:`_plan_heal_counterfactual_check` (route="unknown" fallback; same branch in .github/workflows/plan.yml "Auto-approve clear plan") | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the route cannot be determined, a `hold` result is built without reading `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE_ENABLED`.
  WHY: Setting the flag to `false` does not roll back an unknown-route hold. A cache miss on an ordinary non-heal issue also returns 1, and the poller sends no hold comment, so the issue can sit silently in `ai:awaiting-approval`.
- agents.d/8249-heal-plan-counterfactual-gate.md:1 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fragment documents the counterfactual gate but is appended to the unrelated `## Implement scope-lock label` section (agents.md:1755).
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime, but the gate is documented under the wrong heading. HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: use `re.search(r"(?<![\w-])" + re.escape(name_cf) + r"(?![\w-])", item)` in place of the `in` test (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- prompts/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt:1-4 (and prompts/_templates/mode-plan-heal-counterfactual.txt) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The first content paragraph is the `===` banner (line 2), but `scripts/render_prompt.py:43` `ROLE_GOAL_LINE_RE` requires `Role: ... Goal: ...`. `_extract_identity_recall_metadata_or_raise` (line 510) therefore raises `metadata_extract_failed`, unlike every other shipped prompt.
  WHY: The identity-recall block cannot be rendered for this prompt and the prompt corpus test fails the build (CI run 40660788825, job 122723013069). The fix is to delete the banner or move it after the Role/Goal line.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:212-219, 230-235 (`_evaluate_heal_counterfactual`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The parser iterates `_unfenced_lines(lines)` for the whole plan and approves on a single well-formed `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL:` line without requiring a `## Counterfactual check` section.
  WHY: The gate fails open on any plan containing the marker token in any context (e.g. a quoted example), defeating the purpose of #8249.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:254 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `unmatched = [...]` is an unrestricted substring test of each PARTIAL job name against every `## Deferred scope` bullet (`lint` matches `linter-fmt`, `build` matches `build-image`, `e2e` matches `e2e-smoke-test-fast`).
  WHY: A planner listing `PARTIAL: lint` when only `linter-fmt` is deferred is approved, which is the failure mode #8249 was written to prevent.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18117-18156 and .github/workflows/plan.yml:3017-3037 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unknown-route branch sets `cf_json` with `decision=hold`, `reason=heal_route_unknown` before the gate flag is consulted, in both the poller (line 18133) and plan.yml (line 3020).
  WHY: `HEAL_COUNTERFACTUAL_GATE_ENABLED=false` does not bypass an unknown-route hold, so
